prompt:
Design a desktop website landing screen, 16:9 landscape (1920x1080), rendered as the web page itself edge to edge (no browser window, no device frame, no mockup).

Brand: ROOMi (ROOMiVERSE), a DJ lifestyle brand. Use the attached image as the logo: a graffiti marker wordmark "ROOMi".

Style: a premium fashion-house e-commerce site in the manner of minimal Korean fashion brand sites: lots of white space, a small thin sans-serif, a centered logo, full-bleed photography.

Regions, in order:
1. Thin white top navigation bar. The ROOMi logo in black at the exact center. Left: "Meet ROOMi", "What's Going On", "Let's Party", "Shop". Right: "Cart (0)", "My". Tiny black sans, generous letter-spacing.
2. Full-bleed realistic photograph below the bar: a calm container port at golden hour, stacked containers in muted tones, soft natural light, cinematic depth of field, layered so it could become a parallax scene.
3. Bottom-left over the photo, small white text: "ROOMiVERSE" and "내 방안의 나만의 우주", with a tiny underlined link "Enter →".
4. A tiny hot pink #F71D64 dot as the only accent color.

Quiet, restrained, expensive-looking. No fake prices, no extra cards.
